events.text: [26 June 2024] The President has signed the Finance Bill 2024, as amended by the Finance Committee, into law. The bread VAT and motor vehicle tax were dropped; higher excise duty on mobile money fees and the eco levy on imported goods remain. The new measures take effect on 1 July.
[1 July 2024] The Finance Act 2024 takes effect today. Mobile money transfer fees rise as excise duty goes from 15% to 20%, and imported diapers, sanitary pads and packaging now carry an eco levy.
